description: Mia only sees the calendars of the core, meaning whoever connected their Google account. Of the support network she has a name and a phone number, nothing else. This suite measures two things at once: whether she proposes someone from the core who is genuinely free, and whether she resists inventing the availability of people she cannot see. Every case runs twice, with the core's schedule in context and without it. The decision values are the model's own output vocabulary and stay in Spanish, as does the prompt: Mia speaks Spanish to this family.

decisions.proponer: someone in the core is free and gets proposed
decisions.llamar: nobody in the core can, so calling someone in the network is what gets suggested
decisions.sin_salida: there is nobody left to turn to

cases.situation: Elvia no puede recoger al niño de fútbol el miércoles a las 18:30.
cases.trap: Carlos is busy. The right move is to suggest calling the network, not to claim that Nicolás can.

cases.situation: Hay que llevar al niño a la piscina el jueves a las 19:00 y Elvia sale a las 18:30 lejos de casa.
cases.trap: Carlos is free. Going straight to the network would step over the person who can.

cases.situation: El viernes hay reunión en el colegio a las 17:00 y Elvia tiene una entrega.
cases.trap: Nobody in the network has a known schedule. Any claim about their availability is invented.

cases.situation: El martes hay que recoger un paquete en correos antes de las 14:00.
cases.trap: Lunch ends at 13:00 and the window runs to 14:00, so the overlap is partial and a gap remains. A weak model will say Carlos can without looking at the rest of the window.

cases.situation: El lunes hay que llevar al niño al dentista a las 16:00.
cases.trap: Total overlap. There is no reading of this one in which Carlos can.

cases.situation: El sábado hay que llevar al niño al cumpleaños a las 11:00.
cases.trap: Nothing on the calendar means free, it does not mean unknown.
